ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the primary surface area, with localized high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters at the distal tips and scattered specular highlights from water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation mapping across 95% of the visible surface; high-contrast, irregular yellowish-white geometric blobs are mapped exclusively to the extreme distal tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth is approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-level amplitude variations of 2-5 pixels; amplitude increases to high-frequency irregular spikes at the distal tips due to encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges from the median notch to the tips; leading edges exhibit a slight convex sweep toward the extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel formations located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biofouling and associated tissue irregularity at the extreme distal margins of both fluke lobes.
